notes: Make the Desktop library your own with cover or landscape-banner layouts, adjustable card sizes and spacing, and collections pinned in the sidebar.
Select multiple entries to manage favorites, tags, collections, and hiding together, with Undo for bulk changes.
Remove active filters individually, clear them together, and see result counts. Rename collections, choose their icons and theme colors, and keep your place when closing details.
A simpler Friends page with optional Steam and Discord connections, confirmed profile links, and compact account controls.
Online friends sort by playing, Do Not Disturb, then simply online. Away and outdated presence stay out of Online.
Orbit right-click menus offer relevant actions throughout the app, with keyboard access and familiar text editing.
Read game news in Orbit with working links, inline photos, and a Retry action when an article cannot load.
Clearer installation notifications show game artwork when cached, your Orbit icon, and a View game action. Notifications can reopen Orbit after its window has unloaded to the tray.
Restore hidden games in bulk, recover missing banner artwork, and reach collection creation directly from bulk editing. Text shortcuts and right-click menu navigation work more consistently.
Choose overlay or split Desktop banners, with consistent artwork proportions and clearer crop controls.
Manage Steam downloads, library folders, and optional client controls in one place.
Orbit reopens in Desktop mode after updates and opens visibly at Windows sign-in when Launch at login is enabled. Update controls are in Settings > Manage.
More hidden Desktop and Controller startup scenes, with theme-aware artwork, optional sound, and reduced-motion support.
Cleaner themed setup and menus, balanced Radar panels, and clearer Steam storage and completed-download cards. Settings, themes, artwork, and profile links stay saved.
A simpler Desktop guide covers more of Orbit and returns you to your place. Downloads keeps its queue and filters when Steam controls open.
Restart Orbit from the tray for a full startup. Damaged interface settings recover from a valid saved copy, with original files kept separately.
Match the app icon to your theme or choose a separate style in Appearance, with a preview and a saved choice for the next full restart.
